title: bug: taskless-handoff.test.mjs runs the ps1 QA worktree-mode check that 072dd78c (WT-13) put into its prompt slice, but never stubs Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode, so its 6 PowerShell 5.1 and 7 claimed-qa cases fail under Windows node and CI's Windows "Test agent runtime discovery" step has been red since 11-02 (twin of task-5d517571)
description:
Filed by hunt #22 (task-7a3640da), from a dry run of CI's windows-latest leg at fec9a842 on the Windows host.

PROBLEM
- scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs renders the real ps1 prompt blocks. psContext is the part of scripts/moe-agent.ps1 from `    $dynamicContext = ""` to `    # -------- Pre-flight baseline`, which is lines 10221-10368 at fec9a842. psBody is the part from `    $claimPromptBody = $null` to `    $script:CliLaunchedAt = Get-Date`.
- The PowerShell engines run only on win32. The test's `engines` (:27-30) is `windows ? [bash, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe] : [['bash', '/bin/bash']]`, so the ubuntu leg runs bash alone and stays green.
- 072dd78c (task-fbe8e388, WT-13, 2026-11-02 17:19Z) added this line inside psContext, at moe-agent.ps1:10361:
  `if ($AutoClaim -and $preflightOk -and $preflightTaskId -and $Role -eq 'qa' -and (Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode)) {`
  Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode is defined at :6435, outside the slice. The fixture setup stubs only Initialize-MoeWorktree (test :67-69).
- The setup sets `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'`, so every claimed-qa render throws CommandNotFoundException and exits 1. A worker render short-circuits on `$Role -eq 'qa'` and passes.
- This is the same class as task-5d517571 (DONE 10-31), where the unstubbed helper was Initialize-MoeWorktree and 14 claimed-worker cases failed.

EVIDENCE (Windows node 24.16.0, powershell 5.1.26100, pwsh 7.6.9, all outside the shared checkout)
- CI emulation of the windows-latest leg at fec9a842: a Windows-git clone at D:\moe-scratch\h22\w, no MOE_* variables, CI=true, a fresh USERPROFILE and HOME, and Git Bash first on PATH. Step "Test agent runtime discovery" (ci.yml:266-267) exited 1 with tests 485, pass 477, fail 6. Log: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/logs/w-10-Test-agent-runtime-discovery.log
- First error lines:
  ✖ powershell: claimed qa verification obeys project rails
    AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode : The term 'Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program. ...
    At ...\moe-prompt-jesn4N\prompt.ps1:156 char:86
    + ... lightTaskId -and $Role -eq 'qa' -and (Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode)) {
    1 !== 0
        at render (file:///D:/moe-scratch/h22/w/scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs:89:10)
- The 6 failing cases are powershell and pwsh, each with "claimed qa verification obeys project rails", "claimed headless qa ends after one task" and "claimed interactive qa ends after one task".
- Bisect, single file, `node.exe --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` on a git-archive of scripts and docs:
  - 51ba4f6a (072dd78c^): 106/106 pass;
  - 072dd78c: 100 pass, 6 fail;
  - fec9a842: 100 pass, 6 fail.
  TAPs: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/bisect/{pre,at,tip}.tap
- Fix check: adding `function Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode { $false }` next to the Initialize-MoeWorktree stand-in gives 106/106 at fec9a842 (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-7a3640da/fixcheck/taskless-handoff.tap).
- The slices also call three other Moe helpers they do not define:
  - Stop-MoeVerifiedLocalSeat (:10356) runs only when $script:MoeVmRoute is set, and the fixture leaves it unset;
  - Invoke-MoeQaControlPreflight and Assert-MoeQaLandedCommit (:10362-10363) run only when Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode returns true.

FIX DIRECTION
- Test-only. In render()'s ps setup, add a side-effect-free stand-in `function Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode { $false }` beside the Initialize-MoeWorktree one, with a matching comment: the fixture renders a shared-mode checkout.
- Add a guard that fails on every OS, so the ubuntu leg catches the next unstubbed helper. List each `<Verb>-Moe<Name>` command that the psContext and psBody slices call. Assert that each is defined in the slice, stubbed in the setup, or on a short allowlist of calls the fixture cannot reach. Name each allowlisted call's guard in a comment: Stop-MoeVerifiedLocalSeat, Invoke-MoeQaControlPreflight, Assert-MoeQaLandedCommit.
- Do not edit scripts/moe-agent.ps1: 62ec51f1 and 6b3ab9d8 hold it. Do not edit moe-agent.sh.

FILES: scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs only.
definitionOfDone: Run from a git-archive snapshot of scripts and docs outside the shared checkout, `"/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs` reports fail 0 and skipped 0, with the 6 powershell and pwsh claimed-qa cases passing.

implementationPlan.description:
Edit scripts/tests/taskless-handoff.test.mjs with the Edit tool (a TOOL witness; never git apply, sed or another shell write). The reference diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/arch-99a26cf2/fix.patch (+28/-4), gated at planning on 566778a0 and on the current target tip 7811de41. Read it and reproduce its three hunks byte for byte.
(a) Right after `const psBody = between(...)` (line 24), add a module-level const `psStubs`. It is a plain template literal with no `${`, holding exactly two lines, each on its own line: `function Initialize-MoeWorktree([string]$TaskId, $Claim, $Context) {}` and `function Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode { $false }`, followed by a newline. Above it goes a 4-line comment: the fixture tests prompt rendering, not provisioning; psContext calls real wrapper helpers but excludes their definitions, so each reachable one gets a side-effect-free stand-in; Initialize-MoeWorktree (WT-04) keeps its signature; Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode (WT-13) answers $false because the fixture renders a shared-mode checkout.
(b) In render()'s ps setup, replace the two `# This fixture tests prompt rendering...` comment lines and the `function Initialize-MoeWorktree(...) {}` line with `${psStubs}` on its own line, directly followed by the closing backtick and semicolon.
(c) After the closing `}` of the `for (const [engine, executable] of engines)` loop, and before `// ---- Wrapper-side wait + adoption boundary`, add:
- A comment: the PowerShell renders run only on Windows. Under $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop', a slice call to a helper defined outside the slice throws CommandNotFoundException (task-5d517571: Initialize-MoeWorktree; task-99a26cf2: Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode). This check runs on every OS. A mention in a comment counts as a call, so it fails closed.
- A 2-line `// ponytail:` note: only Verb-MoeNoun names are scanned; scan every function moe-agent.ps1 defines if a slice ever calls one of its few non-Moe helpers (Invoke-PostFlight, Get-RoleDoc).
- `const psUnreachable = new Set([...])` with exactly these entries: 'Stop-MoeVerifiedLocalSeat' (comment: behind $script:MoeVmRoute, which the fixture never sets), and 'Invoke-MoeQaControlPreflight' and 'Assert-MoeQaLandedCommit' (each with the comment: behind (Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode), stubbed to $false).
- ONE test named exactly `ps1 prompt slices call only Moe helpers the fixture defines, stubs or cannot reach`:
  - slices = psContext + psBody;
  - called = new Set(slices.match(/\b[A-Z][A-Za-z]+-Moe[A-Za-z0-9]+\b/g)) (the verb class covers ConvertTo/ConvertFrom);
  - assert.ok(called.size > 0, 'the helper scan matched nothing: its pattern no longer fits the slices');
  - defined = the names captured by /^\s*function\s+(?:\w+:)?([\w-]+)/gm over slices plus a newline plus psStubs;
  - missing = the called names, in scan order, that are neither defined nor in psUnreachable;
  - assert.deepEqual(missing, [], with the template message `ps1 prompt slices call Moe helpers the fixture neither defines nor stubs: ${missing.join(', ')}. Add a side-effect-free stand-in to psStubs, or list a call the fixture cannot reach in psUnreachable with its guard.`).
  The step-2 gate greps that test name and the fragment `nor stubs: Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode. `, so keep both verbatim.
Error handling: every guard assertion carries a message that names each missing helper and the remedy, and the non-vacuity assertion fails when the scan matches nothing. render() keeps its spawn-error and exit-status assertions unchanged.
Leave alone: the four between() anchor strings at lines 22-25 (mem:gotcha-wrapper-slice-tests-execute-text: an edited anchor kills the whole file at import), the bash setup, and every existing test. Keep the file LF and UTF-8 (it holds a 漢字 fixture). Do not edit scripts/moe-agent.ps1 or scripts/moe-agent.sh: 62ec51f1 (now landed as ac3e5afb) and 6b3ab9d8 hold the ps1.

Verification (no edits). Run this from the root of your task worktree (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel`) on this WSL seat: the gate uses the /mnt/c and /mnt/d paths, as the DoD does. Run the plan's verification command, executionContract.checkRefs[0], exactly as written. It makes a git-archive snapshot of HEAD's scripts and docs under /mnt/d/moe-scratch/t99a26cf2.XXXXXX (outside the shared checkout), overlays your edited test file, and runs three checks:
1. Windows node.exe with WSLENV empty, so no seat variable reaches it. Expect w.tap `# tests 107`, `# pass 107`, `# fail 0`, `# skipped 0`, with 6 `ok` lines for the powershell and pwsh claimed-qa cases (DoD 1).
2. Linux node under env -i. Expect l.tap `# tests 45`, `# pass 45`, `# fail 0` (DoD 2).
3. A mutant copy with the one `function Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode` line removed (the command checks that exactly one line went). It must exit 1 with `# fail 1`, and the failing case must be the guard, naming Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode (DoD 2).
The command prints the snapshot path first and GATE-OK last, and takes about 35-40 s (Windows about 30 s). Submit this command, its exit code 0 and its output tail as complete_task's verification.
Then run checkRefs[1] from the same root (DoD 3). It must print the one-file `git diff --stat` and SCOPE-OK. Quote that output in the complete_task summary.
If a check fails, read the TAP files in the printed snapshot dir:
- a Windows CommandNotFoundException means a stand-in is missing or misspelled;
- a mutant that passes means the guard does not read psStubs;
- a missing GATE-OK after green counts means the test name or message drifted from step 1.
Fix only step 1's file, then re-run both commands fresh.
Afterwards, remove the printed snapshot dir by its literal path (`rm -rf /mnt/d/moe-scratch/t99a26cf2.<suffix>`), never with a command substitution as the target. Background: mem:gotcha-launcher-ps1-rows-from-wsl and mem:gotcha-git-bash-native-env-conversion-and-function-stubs (section 3, probing Windows from WSL).

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of your own diff: `git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/moe/work-2026-10-24)`, which should be +28/-4 in this one file. Check each point:
(1) The four between() anchors are byte-identical to HEAD.
(2) psStubs holds no `${` and no backtick, so JS interpolates nothing inside it, and `$false` and `$TaskId` reach PowerShell literally.
(3) The stand-in is the only line in the file that contains `function Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode`. The gate's mutant deletes that line, so a second match would make the mutant vacuous or over-broad.
(4) Each psUnreachable name is still called only behind the guard its comment names in the target tip's moe-agent.ps1. At 7811de41 that is :10424-10425 `if ($script:MoeVmRoute -and $Role -eq 'worker' ...)` and :10430-10432 `... -and (Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode)) {`. If a guard has changed, re-check reachability before keeping the entry.
(5) The 6 claimed-qa ps cases really ran on Windows: ok, not skipped.
(6) The guard spawns nothing and reads only psContext, psBody and psStubs, so it behaves the same on the ubuntu, macos and windows CI legs.
(7) Null and empty input: slices.match returning null gives an empty Set, which the non-vacuity assertion rejects.
(8) Concurrency: the new test writes nothing, and render()'s per-call temp dirs are unchanged.
(9) The moved comment keeps the old rationale (rendering, not provisioning; same signature).
If this review changes any byte, re-run both step-2 commands fresh and submit that output.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1) Stub only, the one-line pattern of task-5d517571 (ad36ff9b). Rejected on its own: the DoD needs a guard that the Linux leg runs, and this class has now recurred twice (WT-04, then WT-13), each time visible only on Windows CI.
2) Keep the stand-ins inline in render() and have the guard parse render.toString() or the test's own source. Rejected as brittle. A module-level psStubs const is the single source that both the PowerShell renders and the guard read, so removing a stand-in breaks both, which the gate's mutant proves.
3) Scan every function moe-agent.ps1 defines (253 at 566778a0, 14 of them not Verb-Moe) instead of the Verb-MoeNoun pattern. More complete, but it needs per-name word-boundary matching, and the nested function `build` false-matches prose in the prompt text. Deferred with a ponytail note: at 566778a0 and 7811de41 neither slice calls a non-Moe wrapper helper.
4) Strip PowerShell comments before scanning. Rejected: the slices' here-strings hold '#' heading lines, and a comment mention only forces a stub or allowlist entry, so the guard fails closed.
5) Flag stale allowlist entries. Rejected: a refactor that moves a call out of a slice would turn CI red with no defect. The allowlist stays a three-name Set with its guards in comments, as the task asks.
6) Make the wrapper call slice-safe in moe-agent.ps1. Out of scope: 62ec51f1 and 6b3ab9d8 hold the file, and the fix direction is test-only.

planningNotes.risks:
- The gate is WSL-specific, like the DoD: node.exe under /mnt/c, and scratch under /mnt/d so that Windows node gets a drive path. Run it from the task worktree root, because `cp "$T"` uses a relative path.
- The gate greps the exact guard test name and the message fragment `nor stubs: Test-MoeControlWorktreeMode. `. Do not rephrase either. Each stand-in must sit on its own line: if both shared a line, the mutant would also drop Initialize-MoeWorktree and the message check would fail.
- Do not edit the between() anchors at test :22-25 (mem:gotcha-wrapper-slice-tests-execute-text).
- psStubs is a JS template literal, so it must hold no `${`. Then `$false` and `$TaskId` stay literal.
- Seat env leak: the gate empties WSLENV for node.exe and runs Linux node under env -i. Do not drop either.
- The scratch dirs /mnt/d/moe-scratch/t99a26cf2.* stay behind. Remove them by literal path: the Bash tool refuses rm -rf with a command substitution as its target.
- The target keeps moving (62ec51f1 landed mid-planning). If a later ps1 landing adds a Verb-MoeNoun call inside either slice, the guard correctly fails. Do not widen psUnreachable without naming the call's guard and confirming that the fixture cannot reach it.
- QA, RED proof: run checkRefs[0] from a scratch clone at <completion>^ (`git clone -q --shared --no-checkout . $S/r && git -C $S/r checkout -q --detach <completion>^`, then run from $S/r). It exits 1 with w.tap `# fail 6`. QA's scope check is `git diff --stat <completion>^ <completion>`, which should list only the test file. checkRefs[1] is worker-side only, because it measures W against its fork point; after landing and the task-branch sync it reads empty.
